Heads up — I pulled the ingestion logs for vendor ZTH-993. The vendor record exists but the PO import job rejected the PO because the external file lacked the 'bill_to_entity_code' attribute we require to link POs to vendor accounts when the supplier identifier is ambiguous. The error line from the ingestion log (excerpt attached) is: 

ERROR: PO ZB-7782 rejected - missing required field 'bill_to_entity_code' - ingest_v2 - 2027-06-24T22:45:12Z

Two options:
1) Manual: I can attach the PO to the vendor record and re-issue a fresh invite token that will be valid for 48 hours. This is fastest and avoids vendor re-upload.
2) Long fix: Ask Zenith to reissue the PO with the bill_to code embedded in the PO metadata (their AP system can add a 'BillTo' field) — this will prevent recurrence but takes vendor-side change.

I recommend option 1 to meet the Monday deadline; I'll do the manual attach now if Alex approves. I'll also add a small UI validation so future uploads warn when the bill_to field is missing.

Ben
